in_hebrew.name: Waclaw
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the Slavs
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Waclaw הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic word ‘wokal’, meaning ‘ruler’ or ‘he who calls’. In Christian context, this name is associated with Saint Waclaw, a prince and martyr who converted to Christianity and was later canonized.
